Method of Attack: Compromising websites to inject malicious JavaScript that displays fake Google Chrome automatic update errors to targeted users, leading to download of a ZIP file disguised as a Chrome update containing a Monero miner malware.

The malware uses BYOVD technique exploiting WinRing0x64.sys vulnerability for SYSTEM privileges, persists via scheduled tasks and registry modifications, disables Windows Update and security product communications, and mines Monero cryptocurrency.
Attack Vector: Compromised websites injecting malicious JavaScript scripts
Indicators of Compromise: Fake Google Chrome error message: 'An error occurred in Chrome automatic update. Please install the update package manually later, or wait for the next automatic update.'
Malware executable 'updater.exe' copied to C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome
Connection to xmr.2miners[.]com for Monero mining
Use of Pinata IPFS service to deliver malicious scripts
Exploitation of WinRing0x64.sys via BYOVD technique
